Package com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller

Class OfferController

java.lang.Object
com.vectorpeaks.backend.controller.OfferController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/offers") @CrossOrigin(origins="*") public class OfferController extends Object
Controller for managing tutoring offers. Provides endpoints to retrieve filtered offers with tutor and subject details. Includes built-in BOLA (Broken Object Level Authorization) protection and security event logging.
Version:
1.4
Author:
EduLink Team

      public OfferController(OfferRepository offerRepository, UserRepository userRepository, SubjectRepository subjectRepository, ReviewRepository reviewRepository, AvailabilitySlotRepository availabilitySlotRepository, OfferSlotRepository offerSlotRepository, BookingRepository bookingRepository)
      Constructs a new OfferController with all required repositories.

      offerRepository - repository for offers
      userRepository - repository for users (tutors)
      subjectRepository - repository for subjects
      reviewRepository - repository for reviews
      availabilitySlotRepository - repository for availability slots
      offerSlotRepository - repository for offer slots
      bookingRepository - repository for bookings

  • Method Details

    • getOffers

      @GetMapping @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()") public List<OfferDto> getOffers(@RequestParam(required=false) String subject, @RequestParam(required=false) String city, @RequestParam(required=false) Boolean onlineOnly, @RequestParam(required=false) String search)
      Retrieves a list of offers optionally filtered by subject, city, online-only flag, or a search text (matching subject or tutor name).
      Parameters:
      subject - optional subject name filter
      city - optional city filter
      onlineOnly - optional flag to show only online offers
      search - optional search text
      Returns:
      list of OfferDto objects matching the criteria

      @GetMapping("/tutor/{tutorId}") @PreAuthorize("(#tutorId == authentication.principal and hasRole(\'TUTOR\')) or hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public List<OfferDto> getOffersByTutor(@PathVariable Integer tutorId)

    • createOffer

      @PostMapping @PreAuthorize("(#request.tutorId == authentication.principal and hasRole(\'TUTOR\')) or hasRole(\'ADMIN\')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> createOffer(@RequestBody OfferCreateRequest request)
      Creates a new tutoring offer.
      Parameters:
      request - the offer creation data (tutorId, subjectId, details, price, offerType, availabilitySlotIds)
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with status 200 OK on success, or error message

    • deleteOffer

      @DeleteMapping("/{id}") @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole(\'ADMIN\', \'TUTOR\')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> deleteOffer(@PathVariable Integer id, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication)
      Deletes an offer by its ID. Includes BOLA protection logging.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the offer to delete
      authentication - the security context containing the logged-in user's details
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with status 200 OK if deletion was successful, or 404 Not Found if the offer does not exist

    • updateOffer

      @PutMapping("/{id}") @PreAuthorize("hasAnyRole(\'ADMIN\', \'TUTOR\')") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> updateOffer(@PathVariable Integer id, @RequestBody OfferCreateRequest request, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication)
      Updates an existing offer with the given ID. Includes BOLA protection logging.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier of the offer to update
      request - the object containing new offer data (tutorId is ignored, statusId is fixed)
      authentication - the security context containing the logged-in user's details
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with status 200 OK on successful update, or 404 Not Found if the offer does not exist
